verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Airweave publishes an llms.txt file with explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' (e.g., appending .md for clean markdown), and docs also describe official skills for agent environments (Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) that let agents set up integrations without explanation each time. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully consumed llms.txt end-to-end.
